rules.name: ouat178-preprod-null-vol
rules.sql: SELECT current_database() AS db_name, inet_server_port() AS port, current_user AS db_user, now() AS db_time
SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, value_date, settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tid AND business_unit = :bu

SELECT bbg_underlying_id, settlement_date, price, vol, updated_timestamp FROM opera.var_price_vol_table WHERE tenant_id = :tid AND settlement_date BETWEEN :sd_from AND :sd_to AND (bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'QW%' OR bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'SB%') AND (price IS NULL OR vol IS NULL) ORDER BY settlement_date, bbg_underlying_id

SELECT bbg_underlying_id, settlement_date, price, vol, updated_timestamp FROM opera.var_price_vol_table WHERE tenant_id = :tid AND settlement_date BETWEEN :sd_from AND :sd_to AND (bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'QW%' OR bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'SB%') ORDER BY settlement_date, bbg_underlying_id

SELECT settlement_date, left(bbg_underlying_id, 2) AS product, count(*) AS row_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE vol IS NULL) AS vol_null, count(*) FILTER (WHERE price IS NULL) AS price_null, max(updated_timestamp) AS last_updated FROM opera.var_price_vol_table WHERE tenant_id = :tid AND settlement_date BETWEEN :sd_from AND :sd_to GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE vol IS NULL OR price IS NULL) > 0 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT bbg_underlying_id, settlement_date, price, vol FROM dbsystemuat.var_price_vol_table WHERE settlement_date BETWEEN :sd_from AND :sd_to AND (bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'QW%' OR bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'SB%') ORDER BY settlement_date, bbg_underlying_id

SELECT bbg_underlying_id, settlement_date, price, vol FROM opera.var_price_vol_table WHERE tenant_id = :tid AND settlement_date BETWEEN :sd_from AND :sd_to AND (bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'QW%' OR bbg_underlying_id LIKE 'SB%')

SELECT business_unit, product_code, primary_code, secondary_code, primary_multiplier, secondary_multiplier, updated_timestamp FROM opera.correl_product_mapping WHERE tenant_id = :tid AND business_unit = :bu
SELECT vol_id, bbg_opt_ticker, expiry_date FROM opera.vol_id_table WHERE tenant_id = :tid AND (vol_id LIKE 'CM QW%' OR vol_id LIKE 'CM SB%') AND expiry_date >= :sd_from ORDER BY expiry_date

expect.reason: any row here makes the WP enrichment throw float(None) and fails the whole batch
NULL vol/price on other products breaks the barrier CSO path the same way
QW and SB near/far legs exist in the window
PG QW/SB price/vol should equal legacy
